interface.signature: def search(txt: str, pat: str) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.expression: isinstance(txt, str) and isinstance(pat, str) and len(txt) >= 1 and len(pat) >= 1 and len(pat) < len(txt)
preconditions.description: txt and pat are non-empty strings, and the length of pat is strictly less than the length of txt.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) - len(pat) + 1 for index in return_value) and all(txt[index-1:index+len(pat)-1] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every index in the returned list is a valid 1-based starting position where pat occurs as a substring in txt, and the substring at each index matches pat exactly.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(txt) - len(pat) + 2) if txt[i-1:i+len(pat)-1] == pat)
postconditions.description: The returned list contains exactly one entry for each occurrence of pat in txt, with no duplicates or omissions.
